correctness.rationale: For all connected finite simple graphs and 1<=K<N, the relative-uniform adjoint is L*(1+ch)=cL0h+[(p-q)-c(p+q-2)]h. True twin endpoints give L0h=-(k+2)h, yielding normalized positive unique stationary density. Conversely, K-sector linear forms identify the graph Laplacian eigenvector and hence adjacent true twins. Exact canonical two-site probabilities yield all edge currents and total variation. Stationary flow cancellation yields EPR; complete graph asymptotics follow algebraically. Exact independent-state generator enumeration: PASS 17040 checks on 770 connected graphs plus larger examples.

value.rationale: A structurally defined complete iff classification for exact nonreversible exclusion states on arbitrary connected backgrounds addresses the literature's difficult localized-drive steady states. The entire stationary measure and network currents are explicit; triangle-local current plus complete-graph total-variation equilibrium with strictly positive entropy production distinguishes statistical proximity from irreversible activity. This is not a routine one-moment exercise or an arbitrary graph slice.
